summary: Implemented Phase 3 of the extension catalog work: added CatalogDisplaySpec support to the protocol display envelope and a gizmoDisplay server helper, then wired the app's extension type, tool-card dispatch, and a new DisplayResult renderer that resolves an extension catalog. Built the search-and-scrape registry's Svelte renderer (SearchResults, SearchHit, ScrapeToolResult), rewired its Pi tool to return the display envelope, and extended the display test suite for the new contract (any tool may carry a display).
decisions: The display envelope now carries an optional `catalog` field so tools can ship specs referencing an extension's custom component catalog alongside the Gizmo built-ins; the protocol parser extracts `spec` from `details` only when `catalog` is absent.
Servers use a new `gizmoDisplay` helper (in @gizmo/extensions) to build the `details` shape that tells Gizmo to render `spec` as a chat card.

ToolCallCard's render order keeps the raw `resultText` block above the collapsible details and now renders the DisplayResult component after the details, only when the tool's result is a display envelope.
DisplayResult constructs a ComponentRegistry from `extension.catalogs[spec.catalog]` and falls back to a 'no component catalog' message when missing.

A display result is no longer restricted to the tool named `display`; any tool whose result carries a display envelope renders it, so the 'does not claim another tool's result' test was updated to assert the opposite.
Inline display tools render their spec outside the collapsed details summary, so catalog components remain visible when the tool body is collapsed.
The search-and-scrape registry's catalog id is `gizmo.search-and-scrape` and registers SearchResults/SearchHit for the search tool and ScrapeToolResult for the scrape tool.
errors: Prettier reported style issues in apps/agent-server/docs/melee-technique-catalog.md, apps/app/tests/lib/features/conversation/display.test.ts, and packages/protocol/src/display.ts (not yet reformatted across the repo).

pnpm check:loc reported 2 files exceeding the 300-line limit: apps/agent-server/tests/sessions/pi-agent-service-events.test.ts (331) and apps/app/src/lib/agent-client/agent-store/SessionCapability.ts (308).

App test suite reported 1 failed test before the contract update: 'inline display tools > does not claim another tool's result' was asserting that only a `display`-named tool renders a display result; after updating to allow any tool with a display envelope the suite passes (14/14).
